_what: The Jungle Room's viewing galleries: the nature live cams our own Watering Hole Hangs page puts on in the background, in the order and the groupings that page has them in.
_source: 2026-09-20: taken from https://stimpunks.org/events/watering-hole-hangs/ — our own published events page — read out of the Knowledge System mirror rather than fetched live, because on stimpunks.org a 301 is a failure and not a pass. The video ids are the hrefs off that page, unchanged. The titles and the channels were NOT typed from the link text: every id was put through YouTube's oEmbed endpoint, and the ones oEmbed refuses were read off the watch page's own ownerChannelName. The groups, their order, and the order within each group are that page's and are not ours to tidy. The notes are ours.
_skipped: The Train Cams group is on the source page and is deliberately not here. Ryan's instruction, 2026-09-20: this room is nature cams. A cab view down a Norwegian line is a fine thing to hang about in and it is not a watering hole.
_rule: NOTHING PLAYS UNTIL YOU PRESS PLAY, the same as every other facade on this street. No iframe, no cookie, no request to YouTube until somebody presses. Nothing is hosted here: every cam is somebody else's camera, pointed at somewhere real, and the people who run it are named on the screen rather than only in the liner notes.
_no_runtime: AND THIS IS THE ONE ROOM WHERE A FACADE CANNOT SAY HOW LONG IT RUNS, because the honest answer is that it does not stop. Every other press-to-play control here carries a runtime — that is the promise that lets somebody decide before they press. A live camera has no runtime to carry, and the reflex fix, storing the length of the stream that happens to be up today, would put a number on the page that is wrong tomorrow. So the promise is kept the other way round: the label says the thing runs until you close it, and the room says out loud that the picture is whatever is happening there right now, which may be darkness, rain, an empty waterhole, or a cam between streams. make-jungle.py REFUSES a cam carrying a length for exactly this reason — the inverse of the check make-latibulum.py runs.
_state: Measured on 2026-09-20 against YouTube's own watch page, not assumed. 'live' means playabilityStatus OK and playableInEmbed true — it gets a screen. 'link' means the cam plays on YouTube and its owner has turned embedding OFF: an iframe there would show a refusal where a picture should be, which is exactly the button-that-never-becomes-a-video failure make-chappell.py exists to prevent, so those get a way out to YouTube and say why instead of a screen that does not work. 'dark' means playabilityStatus UNPLAYABLE: the cam is gone. A dark cam renders nothing at all, and is kept in this file so that its death is written down rather than quietly deleted.
_dark: A DEAD CAM IS REPLACED BY WHOEVER CURATES THE EVENTS PAGE, NOT FROM HERE. Two answered UNPLAYABLE on 2026-09-20: Monterey Bay Aquarium's Live Jelly Cam (m1XcdxjVGos) and CritterVision's Critter Cam (HlJ4aRtYhoo). An id chosen in this repo would be a cam nobody chose, so both were left dark and named in the room's own copy until a replacement arrived from the events page. Both arrived the same day, and BOTH were checked before they went up, because a replacement nobody checked is the original bug with a fresh id on it. The jelly cam came back as a screen. The critter cam came back as a LINK: it plays, but its owner has embedding off across the channel, so a screen would show a refusal where the picture should be. Nothing here is dark now. When one goes dark again: leave the entry, set state to dark, and take the replacement up on the events page — then write a 'replaced' note saying what was measured on it.

groups.name: Watering Hole Cams
groups.sub: The gathering mode this whole thing is named after. A pool in a dry place, and whoever turns up.

cams.title: Live stream in the Namib Desert
cams.note: Desert, a pan of water, and long stretches of nothing at all. Oryx, springbok, jackals, and at night whatever the infrared finds.

cams.title: Okaukuejo waterhole, Etosha National Park
cams.title_verbatim: Namibia: Live stream at the Okaukuejo waterhole in Etosha National Park, Namibia
cams.note: The floodlit waterhole at Okaukuejo. Elephant and rhino come in after dark and the light stays on all night, which makes this the cam to have up at three in the morning.

cams.title: Olifants River — Greater Kruger National Park
cams.title_verbatim: Olifants River | Wildlife Live Stream – Greater Kruger National Park
cams.note: A river rather than a pan, so there is nearly always something in the frame — and nearly always something in the frame doing absolutely nothing, which is the point.

groups.name: Otter Cams
groups.sub: Let the otters do the heavy lifting. Our own events page says so; we are only obeying it.

cams.title: Sea Otter Cam
cams.note: Sea otters in the water, being extremely busy about nothing in particular.

cams.title: Sea Otter Cam 2
cams.note: The second angle on the same otters, which is a different room to them and therefore a different cam to us.

cams.title: Live Sea Otter Cam
cams.note: Monterey's otters. Grooming, mostly. An otter spends an enormous amount of its day on its own coat and is not embarrassed about it.

cams.title: Live Sea Otter Cam (second view)
cams.title_verbatim: Live Sea Otter Cam - Monterey Bay Aquarium
cams.note: The alternate Monterey feed. This one is often between streams; when it is, you get the last one instead, which is still otters.

cams.title: Live sea otter and fur seal cam
cams.title_verbatim: Live sea otter / fur seal cam - Seattle Aquarium
cams.note: Otters and fur seals sharing a frame. The fur seals are louder about it.

groups.name: Ocean and Reef Cams
groups.sub: Underwater, where nothing is in a hurry and the light moves anyway.

cams.title: Live Jelly Cam
cams.replaced: m1XcdxjVGos answered UNPLAYABLE on 2026-09-20. Ryan sent this id the same day. It is the same cam under a new stream — oEmbed returns the same title and the same channel, and the watch page answers OK, playableInEmbed true. Verified rather than assumed, because a replacement nobody checked is the original bug with a fresh id on it.
cams.note: Moon jellies, lit from behind, drifting in a circular tank. The slowest thing in this room and the one most likely to still be on an hour after you meant to close it.

cams.title: Live Kelp Forest Cam
cams.note: A whole forest, swaying. Kelp is the only thing on this page that moves in a way you can watch for an hour without your brain asking what happens next.

cams.title: Live Open Sea Cam
cams.note: Blue, and then a sardine school turns over all at once and it is briefly silver.

cams.title: Utopia Village Sandy Channel Underwater Reef Cam
cams.title_verbatim: Utopia Village Sandy Channel Underwater Reef Cam powered by EXPLORE.org
cams.note: A sand channel between two reefs — the road rather than the neighbourhood, so things are usually passing through it.

cams.title: Utopia Village Top-of-Wall Underwater Reef Cam
cams.title_verbatim: Utopia Village Top-of-Wall Underwater Reef Cam powered by EXPLORE.org
cams.note: The top of the reef wall, where the shallow reef falls away. Busier than the channel and lit better.

cams.title: Live Cam in The Lower Keys
cams.note: Florida water and Florida weather. Sometimes the whole cam is a rain squall, which counts.

cams.title: Coral City Camera
cams.title_verbatim: Coral City Camera (Miami's Free-Range Aquarium Underwater Livestream)
cams.note: A reef growing on a working seawall in the Port of Miami. Urban coral, in a shipping channel, thriving anyway — it is hard to watch this one without reading something into it.

cams.title: Underwater Manatee Cam at Homosassa Springs
cams.title_verbatim: Underwater Manatee Cam At Homosassa Springs | Fall in love with the beloved sea cows! | explore.org
cams.note: Manatees in a spring, moving at the speed manatees move at. The single best argument on this page for going slower.

groups.name: Jungle and Forest Cams
groups.sub: The ones this room is named for. Water, leaves, and a lot of birdsong nobody is performing.

cams.title: Calm woodland stream with birdsong
cams.title_verbatim: Calm Woodland Stream with Beautiful Birdsong | Relax, Stress Relief and Sleep, ASMR
cams.note: A stream and the birds over it. This is the one to put on when you want the room to have a sound in it and nothing to look at.

cams.title: Waterfall in a mountain forest
cams.title_verbatim: Waterfall Flowing in a Mountain Forest 24/7. Waterfall Sounds, Flowing Water. White Noise for Sleep.
cams.note: White noise with a picture on it. Loud in a way that is somehow quiet.

cams.title: Wildlife in the forest, 24/7
cams.title_verbatim: Wildlife In The Forest - 24/7 LIVE 🔴 by Morten Hilmer
cams.note: Morten Hilmer's forest camera. Long empty stretches and then a deer, which is the correct ratio for a forest.

groups.name: Butterfly Cams
groups.sub: Small, erratic, unrepeatable. A different kind of thing to rest your eyes on.

cams.title: Butterfly House Live Cam
cams.note: Zoos Victoria's butterfly house. Often between streams — when it is, the last one is still there, and it is still butterflies.

cams.title: Butterfly Garden 4K
cams.title_verbatim: Butterfly Garden 4K  Relaxing Insect Film with Soothing Music  • 4K Video UHD #5
cams.note: Butterflies, in 4K, with soothing music under them. The one thing in this group that arrives with a soundtrack, and it is on our own events page in the butterfly group, so it is here in the butterfly group.

groups.name: Bird Nests and Feeders
groups.sub: Somebody else's doorstep, and the traffic on it.

cams.title: Big Bear Bald Eagle Live Nest — Cam 1
cams.note: A bald eagle nest in the San Bernardino mountains. In season this is the most dramatic thing on the page by a very long way, and out of season it is a large empty stick basket in a pine.

cams.title: Bird feeder and wildlife cam, Gettysburg, PA
cams.title_verbatim: LIVE Bird Feeder & Wildlife Cam - Gettysburg, PA
cams.note: A feeder in Pennsylvania. Cardinals, jays, a squirrel doing something inadvisable.

cams.title: South Africa bird feeder and wildlife cam
cams.title_verbatim: 🔴 LIVE South Africa Bird Feeder & Wildlife Cam (Hoopoes, Hornbills & More)
cams.note: Hoopoes and hornbills at a feeder, which is a considerably more improbable feeder than the one in Pennsylvania.

cams.title: Burrowing Owl Nest Cam, Oregon
cams.title_verbatim: LIVE Burrowing Owl Nest Cam - Oregon – Owl Research Institute | explore.org
cams.note: The Owl Research Institute's burrowing owls. Owls that live in a hole in the ground, which makes this the one cam here with a door onto the Latibulum.

groups.name: Wildlife
